Event Ticket

Multi-Organization Ticket Sales for BMF 2026

Deployment & Configuration Guide

Quick Start

1 Database Setup

# Run the schema migration
psql -h DB_HOST -p DB_PORT -d DB_NAME -f app/schema.sql

# Import sample BMF organizations
python cli/import-bmf-orgs.py

2 Configure Environment

# Copy environment template
cp app/.env.example app/.env

# Edit with your settings
nano app/.env

3 Start API Server

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Start the server
python app/server.py

4 Access Ticket Shop

# Open in browser
http://localhost/ticket-shop.html?org=mv-st-poelten&event=bmf-2026-stpoelten

Environment Configuration

Variable Description Default
DB_HOST PostgreSQL host 51.158.130.90
DB_PORT PostgreSQL port 25120
DB_NAME Database name abuch
DB_USER Database username (empty)
DB_PASSWORD Database password (empty)
PORT API server port 8010
DEBUG Enable debug mode true
SEPA_API_URL SEPA.digital API endpoint https://api.sepa.digital

Docker Deployment

Build Docker Image

# Build the image
docker build -t event-ticket:latest .

# Or use the registry
docker pull rg.fr-par.scw.cloud/sofort/event-ticket:latest

Docker Compose

version: '3.8'

services:
  # API Server
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.api
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=postgres
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=event_ticket
      - DB_USER=postgres
      - DB_PASSWORD=secret
      - SEPA_API_URL=https://api.sepa.digital
    ports:
      - "8010:8010"
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  # Web Frontend
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    volumes:
      - ./public:/usr/share/nginx/html
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"

  # Database
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=event_ticket
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./app/schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

volumes:
  postgres_data:

Run with Docker Compose

# Start all services
docker-compose up -d

# View logs
docker-compose logs -f

# Stop services
docker-compose down

API Endpoints

Method Endpoint Description
GET /v1/organizations List all organizations
GET /v1/organizations/:slug Get organization details
GET /v1/organizations/:slug/payment-config Get payment configuration
GET /v1/organizations/:slug/events List organization events
GET /v1/organizations/:slug/events/:event Get event with tickets
POST /v1/organizations/:slug/orders Create ticket order
GET /v1/orders/:order_number Get order details
GET /v1/orders/:order_number/status Check payment status
GET /v1/events/upcoming List upcoming events

Adding a New Organization

1. Insert Organization

INSERT INTO organizations (
    slug, name, description, email, phone,
    street_address, postal_code, city,
    iban, bic, recipient_name, payment_reference_prefix
) VALUES (
    'mk-example',
    'Musikkapelle Example',
    'Musikkapelle Example - BMF 2026',
    'info@mk-example.at',
    '+43 1234 56789',
    'Hauptstrasse 1',
    '1010',
    'Wien',
    'AT123456789012345678',
    'BKAUATWW',
    'Musikkapelle Example',
    'BMF2026-EX'
);

2. Create Event

INSERT INTO events (
    organization_id, slug, name, description,
    event_type, venue_name, venue_address,
    start_date, end_date, max_capacity,
    sales_start, sales_end
) VALUES (
    (SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE slug = 'mk-example'),
    'bmf-2026-example',
    'BMF 2026 Example',
    'Bezirksmusikfest 2026 in Example',
    'festival',
    'Festplatz Example',
    'Festplatz 1, 1010 Wien',
    '2026-07-01 14:00:00',
    '2026-07-02 02:00:00',
    5000,
    '2025-12-01 00:00:00',
    '2026-06-30 23:59:59'
);

3. Add Tickets

INSERT INTO tickets (event_id, name, description, price, quantity_total, max_per_order, sort_order)
VALUES
    ((SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = 'bmf-2026-example'), 'Tageskarte', 'Tageseintritt', 15.00, 3000, 10, 1),
    ((SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = 'bmf-2026-example'), 'VIP Ticket', 'VIP Bereich', 50.00, 200, 4, 2);

4. Access Ticket Shop

https://your-domain.at/ticket-shop.html?org=mk-example&event=bmf-2026-example
